errors.evidence: The description reports that the + SFT on D0 bars reached 75% for both the 13B and 70B models, whereas it is approximately 74% and 77% respectively.
The description states that the no SFT bar for the 70B model reaches 71%, while it actually shows around 79%.

The description lacks information about the specific order of the bars within each model category, noting that they are arranged adjacently.
